# Materials Assemble

> > Materials Assemble is a London-based sustainable materials consultancy specializing in bespoke architectural materials, handcrafted Italian glass from Murano, eco-friendly bio-composites, and artisanal ceramics for commercial and hospitality interiors.

The platform connects architects and designers with curated sustainable materials from European craftspeople, including recycled glass panels, Cotto Del Mugello ceramics, anodized metals, textured marble, and bio-based composites. Materials Assemble emphasizes traditional production techniques, eco-conscious sourcing, and custom fabrication for high-end architectural applications.

## Glass Materials & Production

- [Recycled Blown Glass](https://materialsassemble.com/materials-library/product-category/glass/recycled-blown-glass): Eco-friendly Recycled Glass Panels category for architectural applications
- [Light Blue Recycled Blown Glass](https://materialsassemble.com/materials-library/glass/recycled-blown-glass/light-blue-recycled-blown-glass): Light Blue Recycled Blown Glass panels for eco-conscious interiors
- [Float Glass](https://materialsassemble.com/materials-library/product-category/glass/float-glass): Float glass category for commercial facades and architectural applications
- [A-12 Acid Etched Glass](https://materialsassemble.com/materials-library/glass/acid-etched-glass/a-12-acid-etched-glass): A-12 acid etched glass texture by 6:AM Glassworks from Murano, Italy
- [6:AM Murano Glass](https://materialsassemble.com/materials-library/product-category/finished-products/6am): 6:AM handcrafted Murano glass lighting and chandeliers from Italy
- [Glass Production](https://materialsassemble.com/the-craft/glass-production): Traditional Murano glassblowing techniques and sustainable glass production

## Ceramics & Clay Materials

- [Square Cotto Tiles Lustro Verde](https://materialsassemble.com/materials-library/clay-ceramics/cotto-del-mugello/square-cotto-tiles-lustro-verde): Handmade Italian crackle-glazed square tiles by Cotto Del Mugello
- [Square Cotto Tiles Lustro Rosso](https://materialsassemble.com/materials-library/clay-ceramics/cotto-del-mugello/square-cotto-tiles-lustro-rosso): Handcrafted Italian red-glazed square tiles by Cotto Del Mugello
- [Hexagon Tiles Decoration on Beige](https://materialsassemble.com/materials-library/clay-ceramics/cotto-del-mugello/hexagon-tiles-decoration-on-beige): Hexagon ceramic tiles with beige decoration by Cotto Del Mugello

## Stone & Marble

- [Waves Textured Marble](https://materialsassemble.com/materials-library/marble-stones/textured-marble-stones/waves): Waves textured marble with sound wave-inspired tactile surface by Pim Studio
- [Yellow Travertine](https://materialsassemble.com/materials-library/marble-stones/travertine/yellow-travertine): Yellow Travertine natural stone for hospitality and commercial facades

## Sustainable & Bio-Based Materials

- [Fanocel Bio-Composite](https://materialsassemble.com/materials-library/bio-based-materials/organic-waste/fanocel): Fanocel bio-composite from cellulose acetate and agri-food byproducts
- [Bespoke Architectural Textile](https://materialsassemble.com/materials-library/composite-materials/bespoke-architectural-textile): Bespoke i-Mesh architectural textile with high-performance mineral fibers
